id: title:adamleithp:turn the session header s marks into controls

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop application UI migration and component implementation, including PR badge styling and task header rendering.
review.reason: The observed changes demonstrate a substantive, bounded capability improvement. P1.F8.H1 and P1.F8.H2 show a dependency replacement, removing external Radix UI and adopting PostHog's internal Quill component library, which establishes a clearer ownership and compatibility boundary for the Desktop app. P1.F3.H5 and P1.F3.H6 implement specific visual behaviors for PR badges and bream
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and end-to-end behavior of the new components are not fully represented in the supplied hunk observations, and the exact user-facing benefit of the dependency switch is not demonstrated by the code alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a `solid?: boolean` property to `PrVisualConfig` and uses it to switch the badge style for draft PRs.
observations.code_quote: // segments stay whole, so a long session name is what gives.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the PR badge to use a solid, brand-coloured control instead of a tinted one, distinguishing draft state from other states.

observations.behavior: Adds `shrink?: boolean` and `className?: string` props to `BreadcrumbSegment` and applies conditional styling.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows breadcrumb segments to shrink, potentially changing layout behavior when space is constrained.

observations.behavior: Changes the PR badge's variant and class based on the `solid` flag and the PR's lifecycle color.
observations.posthog_connection: Applies the new badge styling and potentially the solid variant to the PR badge, changing its appearance and potentially its accessibility or interaction behavior.
